source_section: §6 P1Q-04 — Faltan E2E de los contratos críticos
run: E2E_PORT=4320, Playwright production build; 6 specs, 22 tests, 2 workers, retries 0
scope: 13 source obligations, NOT 13 independent E2E test cases nor universal recovery/QA certification

cases.witness_case: high-volume pasted text reaches one ready Result and Copy + a secondary Safe format
cases.claim_observed: Pega texto sintético largo, crea Job, completa revisión, copia y compara bytes Copiar/TXT

cases.witness_case: review decisions drive the export gate and the canonical Safe Output
cases.claim_observed: DNI modificado se exige por expectedSafeOutput independiente y bytes Safe TXT

cases.witness_case: review decisions drive the export gate and the canonical Safe Output
cases.claim_observed: Correo restaurado/conservado por decisión explícita aparece en Safe y se advierte

cases.witness_case: review decisions drive the export gate and the canonical Safe Output
cases.claim_observed: Marcado manual de enalapril entra en ReviewSession, se modifica y aparece Safe

cases.source_text: safe export bloqueado con review pendiente
cases.witness_case: review decisions drive the export gate and the canonical Safe Output
cases.claim_observed: Revisión pendiente presenta bloqueo del Gate; sólo revisión completada libera salida

cases.witness_case: a text-layer PDF extracts its text and reaches review
cases.claim_observed: PDF con capa textual muestra texto exacto del fixture en revisión

cases.witness_case: a scanned PDF without text layer fails explicitly and creates no job
cases.claim_observed: PDF escaneado sin capa provoca alerta española y no crea Job; fail-closed

cases.source_text: batch con fallo conserva el fallo
cases.witness_case: a failed batch item stays visible and never blocks the rest of the batch silently
cases.claim_observed: PDF corrupto queda visible como Error, bloqueo factual y recuperación de otros ítems

cases.source_text: navegar batch no equivale a revisar
cases.witness_case: navigation never fabricates review completion and a reviewed batch has no fabricated output
cases.claim_observed: Navegar entre dos documentos deja ambos pendientes; luego aceptar cambia estado

cases.witness_case: composed structured Job traverses Configure → Review → Privacy Gate → Export
cases.claim_observed: UNKNOWN y roles sin resolver muestran 3 pendientes, no existe salida lista previa

cases.source_text: safe export no contiene PII fixture
cases.witness_case: review decisions drive the export gate and the canonical Safe Output
cases.claim_observed: Safe TXT no contiene DNI/teléfono/NHC sin autorizar; correo expresamente conservado sí aparece, conforme D-024

cases.witness_case: review decisions drive the export gate and the canonical Safe Output
cases.claim_observed: Etiqueta visible Confidencial y cabecera inmutable del artefacto; confirmación antes de descarga

cases.source_text: cero requests de red fuera del origen clínico
cases.witness_case: the critical flow issues zero unexpected external requests
cases.claim_observed: Flujo normal con networkRecorder sin violaciones; suite añade falsadores fetch y XHR
